text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, I'll take this youkan, please.

text_block_list.name: Sweet Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's rare to see you with Japanese sweets, Yaeno-chan.
Are they a souvenir for someone?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No, I was thinking of having it myself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm not usually one for sweets,
but for some reason, I just had an irresistible craving for them.

text_block_list.name: Sweet Shop Lady
text_block_list.text: Could it be that your body is craving sugar...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Perhaps Yaeno Muteki is still feeling the fatigue from the race. It looks like we'll need to reconsider our upcoming racing schedule."
